alt: Answering "what is at position p" on a run-length-compressed sequence without expanding it, by building a cumulative-length array from the run lengths and walking it until a boundary passes the query position.

steps.caption: 3 runs make up the sequence, each far too long to store one slot per position. cumulative starts with one entry, 0, before any run is counted.
cumulative[1] is cumulative[0] plus the length of run 0 (R, length 12): 0 + 12 = 12.
cumulative[2] is cumulative[1] plus the length of run 1 (G, length 3): 12 + 3 = 15.
cumulative[3] is cumulative[2] plus the length of run 2 (B, length 7): 15 + 7 = 22.
cumulative[0] = 0 is at or before 0, and cumulative[1] = 12 is past it: position 0 falls inside run 0, so the answer is R.
cumulative[0] = 0 is at or before 11, and cumulative[1] = 12 is past it: position 11 falls inside run 0, so the answer is R.
Position 13: cumulative[1] = 12 is at or before it, so run 0 (R) ends too early. Move to run 1.
cumulative[1] = 12 is at or before 13, and cumulative[2] = 15 is past it: position 13 falls inside run 1, so the answer is G.
Position 21: cumulative[1] = 12 is at or before it, so run 0 (R) ends too early. Move to run 1.
Position 21: cumulative[2] = 15 is at or before it, so run 1 (G) ends too early. Move to run 2.
cumulative[2] = 15 is at or before 21, and cumulative[3] = 22 is past it: position 21 falls inside run 2, so the answer is B.
